Actor: EO 254 itself. The dossier holds no own-terms record for this order, so the end cites the order's complete held text, which contains the stated day.

research_rationale:
EO 254 (February 18, 1904, Theodore Roosevelt), read in full in the held ProQuest replica scan (archival_replica_scan_pending_codebook, acceptable_as_original false) and checked against the page image I rendered on 2026-10-28 from the held PDF ('ProQuest Pre-1937 Orders/PT1-1904-EO-254.pdf', sha256 63a96efb..., the registered source hash; one page). The image shows the heading 'EXECUTIVE ORDER.', one sentence, the signature 'THEODORE ROOSEVELT.' and 'White House, February 18, 1904.'; it bears no printed order number. Identity rests on the ProQuest record 1904-EO-254, the census register row EO:254 (1904, ProQuest) and the WPA 1944 numbered list entry No. 254 (February 18, 1904: 'Federal offices in Ohio ordered closed Feb. 19, 1904, for funeral services of Marcus A. Hanna'), which agree with the text. The OCR layer is badly degraded ('monory' for memory, 'sours' for hours, 'ninetoenth inetant' for nineteenth instant, 'THEOTORE'); the page image reads: 'As a mark of respect to the memory of Hon. Marcus A. Hanna, late Senator of the United States from the State of Ohio, it is hereby ordered that all Federal offices in Ohio be closed during the hours of the funeral to-morrow, Friday, the nineteenth instant.' Inventory correction: the dossier's machine clause span (characters 580-685) is OCR noise from the blank lower page; the corrected scope EO:254#corrected-1 covers characters 163-565 of the held text, from the heading through the date line. The type label office_closing_mourning fits. First end: by its own terms on 1904-02-19, the only day it governs; the closing ran only during the funeral hours that day, so the order had no operation after that day. February 19, 1904 was a Friday, consistent with 'to-morrow, Friday' written on February 18. The hour the funeral ended is not held and does not affect the recorded date. Searches on 2026-10-28: the WPA 1944 list and census titles for Hanna (no other entry concerns Senator Hanna's death or funeral); a full-text search of every held order text for 'Hanna' with 'funeral' (only this order); a citation search of every held order text for 'Order No. 254' (only navigation links in the Wikisource pages for EO 253 and EO 255).
